tabs.label: SOME– Grubu (Biri / Bir şey…)
rows: Somebody knocked on the door. / Someone is waiting for you outside.
Something is wrong. / I have something to tell you. / Give them something to eat.
I need to go somewhere different. / Ali lives somewhere in Ordu. / I left my keys somewhere in the kitchen.

tabs.label: Gramer Notları
rows: Everybody / Everyone / Everything tekil sayılır → is / was / has alır. Örnek: Everyone IS here. ✓
Everybody knows THAT they are lying. / Ali thinks THAT he knows everything.
Somebody, Something, Somewhere genellikle olumlu cümle ve isteklerde kullanılır.
Somewhere / Something + sıfat: I want to go somewhere different. / I need something warmer.
Deserve = hak etmek. Telaffuz: Dİ-ZÖRV. Örnek: Everybody deserves to be happy.
Celebrate = kutlamak. Örnek: Everybody in the office celebrated my birthday.
